sloka: चक्रुः सर्वाणि कर्माणि यथा कल्पम् यथा विधि ।ततः कालेन महता विश्वामित्रो महातपाः ॥१-६०-१०॥
transliteration: cakruḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi yathā kalpam yathā vidhi ।tataḥ kālena mahatā viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ ॥1-60-10॥

translations.english: Long after, the mighty ascetic Viswamitra invoked all the gods to partake their share of offerings.
